title: Bound quiet terminal lifts of productive public helpers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On the exact #7334 word, ask whether a productive public helper can stop at its penultimate chart, deleting a quiet final paid ascent while retaining positive productive rank. All 1,101 helper trajectories are accounted for. Among 616 rank-nine helpers, 615 come from the current contact census and the protected helper 319 has a retained late scalar contact in its final chart. Among 485 other helpers, 472 inherit a final scalar contact, eight inherit a single whole-exit MOVE with zero residual rank, and five changed roles retain a last scalar contact in their literal final chart. No helper has a proper quiet final ascent. The complete compatible saving in this scope is zero, with no unresolved cases.

## Task and overlap

Use [#7334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7334) at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` and signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7331](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7331) establishes an abstract rank-bill opportunity. [#7386](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7386) supplies current rank-nine chronology. This package reconciles the full literal population, including 485 other helpers and role 319. The package is the only new commit, stacked on two existing [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI commits.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-quiet-public-terminal-lifts-bound/replay.py
```

The clean metadata-only replay authenticates exact source, both census receipts and the constructor contact edit set, then checks the complete partition. Two receipts reproduce and three altered-input controls reject. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, navigation and Git-free export passed locally. No native decode or new supplier replay was needed for this metadata-bound exclusion.

## Credit

#7314 and its exact contact receipt supply the predecessor trajectories, #7334 the changed constructor, #7338 independent admission, #7386 the current affected rank-nine chronology and #7331 the abstract rank-bill precedent. #7113 supplies the signed application. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Moving a later scalar contact, changing a paid itinerary, or allowing the productive rank to reach zero changes the tested family and needs a new compatible price.
